tasks.instruction: Load the readr and dplyr tidyverse packages.
Load the file cars85.csv into a dataframe called cars.
Inspect cars with head() and summary().
Remove the normalized_losses column from cars. Save to cars.
Print the column names of cars.
Rename symboling to risk_factor. Print column names to confirm.
Create a variable called mpg_threshold with the value 30.
Add a new column mpg_diff_from_threshold measuring how far each car's highway mpg is from 30. View the updated dataframe.
tasks.code:
cars <- cars %>%
  mutate(mpg_diff_from_threshold = highway_mpg - mpg_threshold)
head(cars)

tasks.instruction: Filter rows where mpg_diff_from_threshold is greater than 0. Save to mpg_exceeds_threshold and view it.
Arrange mpg_exceeds_threshold by mpg_diff_from_threshold descending. Save as mpg_exceeds_threshold.
Order the rows of cars by engine_size descending. Save to ordered_by_engine_size. View it.

Reflect on the analysis process and how it eases the stress of buying a car.
tasks.code:
# Analysis complete!

# sorted by engine size, and narrowed down by make.
# This data-driven approach helps make an informed decision

# Task 1
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=TRUE}
# load libraries
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
```
# Task 2
```{r error=TRUE}
# load data
cars <- read_csv('cars85.csv')
```
# Task 3
```{r error=TRUE}
# inspect data
head(cars)
summary(cars)
```
# Task 4
```{r error=TRUE}
# select columns
cars <- cars %>%
  select(-normalized_losses)
```
# Task 5
```{r error=TRUE}
# view columns
colnames(cars)
```
# Task 6
```{r error=TRUE}
# rename column
cars <- cars %>%
  rename(risk_factor = symboling)
colnames(cars)
```
# Task 7
```{r error=TRUE}
# define threshold
mpg_threshold <- 30
```
# Task 8
```{r error=TRUE}
# add column
cars <- cars %>%
  mutate(mpg_diff_from_threshold = highway_mpg - mpg_threshold)
head(cars)
```
# Task 9
```{r error=TRUE}
# filter rows
mpg_exceeds_threshold <- cars %>%
  filter(mpg_diff_from_threshold > 0)
mpg_exceeds_threshold
```
# Task 10
```{r error=TRUE}
# arrange rows
mpg_exceeds_threshold <- mpg_exceeds_threshold %>%
  arrange(desc(mpg_diff_from_threshold))
```
# Task 11
```{r error=TRUE}
# order rows by engine size
ordered_by_engine_size <- cars %>%
  arrange(desc(engine_size))
ordered_by_engine_size
```
# Task 12
```{r error=TRUE}
# choose make
chosen_make <- 'toyota'
```
# Task 13
```{r error=TRUE}
# filter rows by make
chosen_make_details <- cars %>%
  filter(make == chosen_make)
```
# Task 14
```{r error=TRUE}
# order filtered rows by engine size
chosen_make_details <- chosen_make_details %>%
  arrange(desc(engine_size))
chosen_make_details
```
